name: CATEC Career and Technical Programs (Charlottesville Area Technical Education Center)
org: Charlottesville Area Technical Education Center (CATEC), run by Charlottesville City Schools
what_you_do: Take hands-on career and technical classes in Auto Service Technology, Carpentry, Cosmetology, Culinary Arts, Electricity, Emergency Medical Technician, Fire Science, Nurse Aide and Patient Care Technician, or Veterinary Science.
grades: Not stated on the pages read
who_can_apply: Classes are free for Charlottesville City Schools and Albemarle County Public Schools students. The pages read do not list grade levels. They do not list the steps to enroll.
pay_detail: Free for Charlottesville City and Albemarle County students. Students earn high school elective credits, can earn industry certifications, and some programs offer dual enrollment college credit. Transportation to and from your base school is provided.
duration: School year classes. Program lengths and schedules are not stated on the pages read.
deadline_text: No enrollment dates are posted on the pages read. Ask your school counselor or CATEC.
how_to_apply: The pages do not describe an enrollment process. Ask your school counselor. Contact CATEC at 434-245-2419 or catecinfo@charlottesvilleschools.org. The 2026 to 2027 Program of Studies PDF is linked from the CATEC high school program of studies page.
notes: Confirm first. Grade levels and enrollment steps are not on the pages read. For 2026 to 2027, CATEC does not offer some academic courses. They are Biology II, English 12, USA Government, and Economics and Personal Finance. EMT and Fire Science are no longer dual enrollment through CVCC. Students still earn CTE credits. Address: 1000 East Rio Road, Charlottesville.
